messages:
Miguel (Sales): Heads up — Orchid Health asked if we can pin `mistral-7b-v2` (quantized) in EU + APAC for their pilot. They want dedicated capacity + SLA. high priority from the AE :urgent:
Anna (PM): Thanks — do we have the model in the catalog today? any licensing or infra blockers?
catalog-bot: Model not present in catalog index. entry: missing artifacts + license verification.
Jia (Onboarding): License check first. Also need: (1) quantized weights (4-bit/8-bit) artifacts, (2) expected memory/CPU per replica, (3) recommended batch size. Can we get a sample payload for perf targets?
Miguel (Sales): Customer targets: ~100 rps, 512 token avg, p95 latency < 250ms, strict data residency for EU and SG. They're open to Dedicated reserved capacity.
Priya (Eng-Platform): Quick notes: 100 rps at 512 ctx on a 7B quantized model => on A100-ish we might need pooling + KV cache + batching tuned. For APAC SG region, capacity is limited this month. Fallback plan required. Also need to confirm runtime supports the exact quant format (4-bit NF4) — if not, we may need to serve int8, which could change memory/latency.
Anna (PM): Ok, scope items we need to decide: (A) onboarding (catalog entry/license/benchmarks), (B) region pin + capacity (APAC/EU), (C) SLA tier and pricing (dedicated commit), (D) fallback strategy (hosted compatible model).
Jia (Onboarding): Action: ask customer to provide sample prompt set + expected concurrency profile. I'll run local perf with `mistral-7b-v2` open artifacts if they can share.
Miguel (Sales): I'll get them to share prompts + a license contact. They asked for a one-week turnaround to see feasibility.
Priya (Eng-Platform): If they need p95 <250ms, we should scope a dedicated pool (2-3 GPU) in EU and 1 in APAC as a starter. Estimate: 2 x A100 EU + 1 x A100 APAC. Rough ops cost estimate ~ $Xk/month — I'll refine.
Anna (PM): Prioritization: recommend we treat this as a customer-driven pilot (priority: high) but with gating criteria: (1) license/artifact received, (2) perf benchmarks meet p95 target on our infra, (3) customer signs a 3mo min commit for Dedicated. If any gate fails, fallback to hosted Mistral-int8 or alternative open model.
catalog-bot: Checklist created: [license, artifacts, quant-format, bench-results, infra capacity]. Ticket #CAT-4721 created.
deploy-bot: Queue note: region capacity check pending (eng-plat).
Jia (Onboarding): If they can't provide 4-bit weights, we can try quantize-in-house but need privacy signoff; would add ~3 business days.
Miguel (Sales): Customer prefers we do quantize if needed, they'll sign NDA. They want price delta if we do in-house quantization and dedicated pool.
Priya (Eng-Platform): I'll validate runtime support and run a quick baseline on int8/4-bit variants. ETA 48h.
Anna (PM): Tentative plan: (1) Miguel collects artifacts + prompt set by EOD Tue, (2) Jia runs initial bench Wed-Thu, (3) Priya confirms infra fit and cost Thu-Fri, (4) final go/no-go by next Monday. Can everyone ack? :thumbsup:
Jia (Onboarding): Ack.
Priya (Eng-Platform): Ack.
Miguel (Sales): Ack — I'll push for artifacts today.
Anna (PM): I'll draft launch gating doc and pricing note after we get bench numbers.
catalog-bot: Linked ticket: CAT-4721 -> ENG-9823 for infra validation.
deploy-bot: Noted — capacity hold request submitted to capacity-ops for APAC.
Miguel (Sales): One more ask from the customer: they want model version pinning across updates (no surprise upgrades). Is that standard?
Anna (PM): Yes, we support version pinning. We'll include explicit pin + rollback policy in the contract.
Miguel (Sales): Great, thanks everyone. I'll update the customer and add them to the CAT ticket once artifacts are in.
Anna (PM): Closing note — priority: high but gated. I'll follow up with a summary doc once bench results are in.
